capabilities: Convert hyphens to raya while typing at line start or anywhere
Fix dialogue dash spacing and punctuation with a command
Insert a raya via command or hotkey
Leave hyphenated words, numbers, links, code and frontmatter untouched
extras: Manual installation only; rules follow correctores.es guidance on guiones largos.
problem: Obsidian has no support for Spanish dialogue typography, so writers must manually type rayas and correct spacing around incisos like —dijo Víctor—.
summary: Spanish typography plugin that converts hyphens into dialogue dashes (raya) and fixes spacing and punctuation around narrator incisos.
